preamble: Normal (presented in alphabetical order of corresponding entries) Twelve clues are normal; their solutions should each have a pair of letters inserted before entry into the grid wherever they will fit. (There are four pairs of letters, each inserted into three answers, always resulting in real words.) In the remaining sixteen clues, the wordplay omits one letter from the solution. When these sixteen omissions are added, the logic behind the pairs of inserted letters will become apparent.

solutions.check: grid and clues read from the Guardian's printable PDF, its numbering matching the clue list; each light's entry one fifteensquared prints for it, the only choice of them whose crossings all agree; an entry not its answer carries the answer as its alteration's `from`
